Implementation complete. Summary:

- `gateway.go`: `NewServer` builds a `net/http.ServeMux` serving `GET /healthz`, `GET /accounts` (with the `active` query-param filter and 400 on invalid values), `GET /accounts/{id}` (404 on unknown id), returns 404 for unmatched paths, and 405 (via explicit `HEAD` registrations plus `ServeMux`'s automatic 405 for other methods) for known paths with disallowed methods.
